body.title: A fork on the paper's licence, ended by the author
body.beside: Forked from the second session of 2026-11-06 to weigh the paper's licence while the second session drew branches on it; the third session to run at once that day.
body.ended: Declared ended by the author, as the Shinto ideal death: its store written, its end declared, then removed.

from.says: The session it was sent from.

to.says: The session it was sent to.

body.says: Words sent from one session to another: a point where the sessions converge, pointed at by both and held by the one that sent it.

body.title: A licence held as a holon
body.opens: A work's licence is a holon its holons point at, so provenance is structural: whatever is drawn from it keeps the chain back by reference, and the engine can refuse to let anything whose provenance reaches a no-derivatives licence leave the store.
restsOn: the engine judging pushes and publishing
how far a chain of references is read

body.title: Blockchaining as a mode of the store
body.opens: Not a store of its own but a mode, decoupled: a commit's name set into a public chain, the chain reached as an integration, the anchoring a holon in the field, interfaceable through full transparency.

body.title: Branding decoupled holarchically
body.opens: The CV and all toward the author's own branding stand in a holarchy of their own, so what is non-commercial by licence never stands under what is commercial.
restsOn: where the line between the two holarchies is drawn in the store
